stops.name: Hallstätter See
stops.detail: Lake Hallstatt is a mountain lake in the Upper Austrian part of the Salzkammergut, at the northern foot of the Dachstein massif, and is located at 508 m above sea level.

stops.name: Seeklause in Steeg
stops.detail: The water level is regulated by the Seeklause in Steeg.
